description: An IBUFDS_GTE2 that feeds only GTREFCLK0 of a GTPE2_COMMON writes IBUFDS_GTE2_Y0.IN_USE
exercises: the IN_USE bit of the GT reference clock buffer in the FASM writer
a reference clock that reaches the transceiver and nothing in the fabric
why: Vivado sets IBUFDS_GTE2_Y*.IN_USE when the buffer's output goes only to a transceiver reference clock input (GTREFCLK0/1 of the COMMON, or of a GTX channel on its CPLL), and leaves it clear when O or ODIV2 also, or only, reaches a fabric clock buffer. openXC7/nextpnr#97 stopped writing the bit for every buffer, from Vivado builds that all had O on a BUFG, so release 2026-10-15 never writes it: the openPCIE x4 build of openXC7/nextpnr#88 differs from its Vivado golden by this bit. The design assembles either way.
